what: Two blind sheets (front opaque · back at .8 opacity) cover the screen, and small uppercase text in the center rises from under a mask over 1s starting at 1.6s. At 3.5s the text panel begins fading over 1.2s, and the front sheet (delayed 1.4s) and the back sheet (.1s later still) lift upward over 1.3s on the same curve cubic-bezier(.83,0,.17,1), revealing the screen like layered shadows. When lifting starts it fires fx:reveal (the place to hook the next motion, such as wordmark letters rising), then hides at 4.8s and fires fx:done

options.at: When the cover starts lifting (seconds), default 3.5 — also settable via the --fx-at variable
options.wait: If load, the clock starts only after all images have arrived (the original uses window load)
options.--fx-at: When the curtain starts lifting, default 3.5s
options.--fx-hide: When the panel is hidden and fx:done fires, default 4.8s
options.--fx-text-at: When the text starts to rise, default 1.6s
options.--fx-back-dur: Length of the back layer lifting away, default 1.3s
options.--fx-fade: Duration of the text panel blur, default 1.2s
options.[data-fx-part=box]: Text panel — inside [data-fx-part=The first child of text] rises from below the masking box

use: Brand Line
note: To show it only to first-time visitors, the caller reads a localStorage flag and removes or attaches the element (the original leaves a flag after 3 seconds and removes the loader from then on). For screens opened often, like apps, shorten at and hide

from.where: index.html #top-loading — original .l-loading: :before 1.4s · :after (opacity .8) 1.3s 3.6s · __wrap fade 1.2s 3.5s · __text>span 1s 1.6s · panel hide --headerDelay 4.8s, curve cubic-bezier(.83,0,.17,1)
